title: One tiny ADCode test for your Monday build 😅
text:
I'm building ADCode, and today's ask is small: try one real task and tell me where the workflow gets awkward.

Pick a CSS glitch, a small Python script, or one bug you already understand. Open that project in ADCode, connect your AI provider key or a compatible local model, and ask for the smallest useful change. Read the changed code, then run it in the terminal. Did it actually solve the task?

A starting prompt: 'Explain this bug, propose a small fix, and tell me how to check it.'

The 'get paid to build' idea: the Windows/Linux editor is free and open source. Occasional sponsored cards fund it, and 50% of that revenue is credited to the developer. Earnings vary; cloud AI usage costs are separate. macOS isn't available yet.

Downloads: https://adcode.bluethenics.com/versions?utm_source=producthunt&utm_campaign=oct05_first_task

If you try it, share your OS, provider/local model, and the first step that got confusing. Happy to help here.
